name: IceTube
summary: YouTube subscriptions and search inside Jellyfin
description: A YouTube client inside Jellyfin (IceSuite): subscriptions and search, per-video quality choice, play-while-downloading, a time-limited cache, permanent downloads, SponsorBlock and SyncPlay support. Alpha builds: not for daily use.
notes: In Jellyfin, add the alpha or beta repository (see set up), then install IceTube from the plugin catalog.
The source repository is private for now; every release carries a source tarball (icetube-src_<version>.tar.gz).
